methods.candidate_workaround: Use rg --files to enumerate matching files and pass exact paths to the content search.

methods.recurrence_guard: Never pass an unexpanded Windows wildcard as an rg path argument; enumerate then search exact paths.

methods.candidate_workaround: Inspect exact current context, split the failed multi-file patch into smaller patches, and apply each only against verified lines.
methods.failure_signature: A multi-file apply_patch request is rejected atomically because one expected context line no longer matches the current file.
methods.recurrence_guard: Read exact context immediately before a multi-file patch and split unrelated edits when any long prose anchor is involved.
methods.rollback: Rely on apply_patch atomic rejection, verify no partial diff, and leave the last clean logical state unchanged.
methods.scope_boundary: Local patch-recovery evidence only; no scientific, production, or independent-reproduction credit.
methods.title: Atomic patch context recovery with smaller verified edits
trigger_preconditions: A multi-file patch includes long generated prose or several unrelated context anchors.

methods.candidate_workaround: Exclude only the exact inherited test method whose commit-cap assertion is scoped to its original phase, while running every other inherited closeout test.

methods.recurrence_guard: List every inherited exclusion by fully qualified test identifier and preserve all other inherited assertions.
methods.rollback: Restore the broad failed selection receipt if the exact filtered selection does not pass; do not weaken current-phase tests.

methods.title: Exact inherited phase-local commit-cap test quarantine

methods.candidate_workaround: Bind x1 historical assertions to the immutable x1 Git blob and regenerate authoritative x2 negative mirrors before rerunning the aggregate selection.

methods.recurrence_guard: Read historical counts from exact Git blobs and refresh authoritative and derived mirrors before any aggregate rerun.
methods.rollback: Retain the failed selection receipt, restore no history, and rerun only after current ledgers and historical assertions agree in their declared domains.
methods.scope_boundary: Validation-order recovery only; no scientific, production, or independent-reproduction credit.

methods.candidate_workaround: Retain the timeout, isolate each probe, disable login-profile semantics, and give the observed Windows startup envelope a bounded sixty-second limit.

methods.title: Isolated no-profile closeout probes after parallel-wrapper timeout

methods.candidate_workaround: Retain the parser fault and split the inspection into literal single-quoted ASCII search patterns and separate exact-path reads.

methods.rollback: Retain the pre-execution parser error and make no repository change before the corrected read-only probe.
methods.scope_boundary: Inspection-wrapper recovery only; no scientific, production, security, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
methods.title: Literal ASCII inspection wrapper after Unicode quote-parser fault

methods.candidate_workaround: Retain the failed 67-test closeout receipt, bind Method Flow parity and negative totals to the declared evidence or closeout lifecycle boundary, regenerate the final mirrors, and rerun the unchanged closeout selection.

methods.title: Lifecycle-scoped Method Flow parity and negative-total validation
trigger_preconditions: A closeout validator reuses evidence-boundary assertions after append-only lifecycle failures are retained.
